stages.name: bump
stages.brief: Bump every package to {{version}} and assemble CHANGELOG.md's {{version}} section ({{date}}) from changes/. Then commit everything both commands changed as `release: v{{version}} — <theme>` (<theme>: a few words naming what the section ships) and push it to the release branch: `git push origin HEAD:{{release_branch}}`.

stages.name: release-pr
stages.brief: Open the release PR: `gh pr create --base {{default_branch}} --head {{release_branch}} --label no-changelog --title 'release: v{{version}} — <theme>'` (the theme of the bump commit), its body the changelog section's bullets and then the Closes lines under "Release PR body", each exactly as written. Never merge it: volleyd squash-merges it on the owner's release_go.

stages.name: tag
stages.brief: Tag the release's merge commit (your HEAD) with the annotated tag v{{version}} and push the tag, nothing else.

stages.name: deploy
stages.brief: Deploy v{{version}} to the supervisor and its paired machines. Publish your stage result with `deployed: "v{{version}}"` once `volley deploy` exits 0.
